Extracts response metadata from HTTP headers (etag, server, content-language)

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { createEngine, scrape } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engine = createEngine(null);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await scrape(engine, url);
  console.log(result.statusCode);
  console.log(result.responseMeta?.etag);
  console.log(result.responseMeta?.lastModified);
  console.log(result.responseMeta?.server);
  console.log(result.responseMeta?.contentLanguage);
}

void main();
```
